thread:
anya: quick flag  we've got ~75 inbound leads over the last 9h with owner=null. Sales complaining.

lucas: yep, enrichment webhook timeouts. our RR assign only fires on enrichment.complete so leads sit unowned.

olivia: propose a fallback: assign to a placeholder queue after 7m, mark crm_sync_allowed=false and set routing_note='Fallback:EnrichPending'. keeps SDRs able to triage without pushing to SF.

sam: agree. also add exponential retry with jitter (15s,45s,2m,6m) before fallback. add alert when webhook 5xx >15% over 5m.

anya: need messaging for SDRs: owners assigned within 10m; fallback queue used if enrich delays, no SF push until enrichment completes. i'll draft.

lucas: middleware change: check crm_sync_allowed flag before pushing to SF. will make toggle so we can rollback fast.

olivia: i'll implement workflow in staging today, replay failed webhooks to verify fallback and reassign on enrichment arrival. screenshots to follow.

sales-ops-bot: created SO-1457 to update SDR playbook with fallback behavior.

hubspot-sync-bot: enrich service reported intermittent 504s; logged ENG-7241.

anya: owners: olivia (workflow), lucas (middleware), sam (alerts + runbook), anya (comms). ETA: staging changes today, prod tomorrow after smoke tests.
